body.objective: Test whether the already classified fixed reflection-even endpoint-extension freedom of the public Bateman--Turok Jordan kernel can supply the forced two-dimensional cross-Krein complement needed to place the public R_t leg and the physical first-emission map in one dilation, and classify the exact kinematic dependence required if a pointwise match remains possible.
activates: an exact matching law between endpoint jets and the missing public-to-physical Krein complement
a universality test over distinct exact physical external-jet fixtures
the next search for a genuinely dynamical zero-mode or higher-composite complement
body.current_gate: On the fixed two-profile probe lift v=(1,z(1-z)), reconstruct the triple-plus reference extension and the three reflection-even endpoint jets E_n=delta_0^(n)+(-1)^n delta_1^(n). Form the induced symmetric Gram K_ab=(H_plus+sum_n c_n E_n)[v_a v_b]. Solve K=G_missing(rho), where G_missing=[[0,-rho],[-rho,-2]], and determine whether one rho-independent coefficient triple can match every exact physical rho fixture. Separate a fixed universal local extension from a pointwise kinematics-dependent fit and keep the latter underived unless BT dynamics supplies it.
body.stop_condition: Land a strict exact certificate with a method-distinct verifier that reconstructs the endpoint actions, solves the affine matching system, checks every imported physical rho fixture, and either proves a fixed extension works universally or records the first exact nonuniversality obstruction together with the necessary pointwise coefficient law. Keep all claims outside the declared fixed-profile lift, all-order Eq. 19, complete BT scattering, gravity, and Lorentzian physics fail-closed.
body.forbid: no counterterm-only coefficient formula that drops the affine reference extension; no fixed-profile obstruction promoted to a no-go for every spectator-dependent or dynamically generated endpoint sector; no pointwise fitted coefficient called BT-derived; no endpoint matching called all-order Eq. 19, complete probability, a physical S matrix, gravity, a new dimension, or a LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL theorem
body.resource_hint: For v_0=1 and v_1=z(1-z), the three products are the certified probes f_0=1, f_1=z(1-z), f_2=z^2(1-z)^2. The endpoint-jet action matrix is [[2,0,0],[0,-2,-4],[0,0,4]], while the triple-plus reference acts by (0,0,3/2). Therefore K=[[2c0,-2c1-4c2],[-2c1-4c2,3/2+4c2]]. Exact matching to [[0,-rho],[-rho,-2]] should be checked rather than assumed; compare the resulting coefficient triple on all imported physical rho fixtures and prove which coefficient must vary.
